additional_info.subject: NOte
additional_info.body:
Charger Offline on SCB
DC1 CCS not in use but LED is Blue.
Charger was last Online on AWS 15/05/25 till 09:33 AM
Not possible to check Actual HMI Status VIA SSH, So Site visit will be required to check HMI
need to follow Q feedback:Q2302
Carry spare DP Cable & Monitor with DP port to check actual status of Charger HMI .
IF Power seems to be Ok & if Logic update didn't resolve the issue, then connect DP cable with Monitor & if HMI screen  appears properly on Monitor then HMI of Charger need to be replaced.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0425633-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P0 312561850/18] Black screen and PDC unavailable. CRM:02888000004
additional_info.body:
Dear Nicolas Raymond,
As checked the charger on SCB, The charger is offline on SCB from 15/09/25 : 09:33 AM so it was not possible to check the actual HMI Screen status VIA SSH Access.
It is also observed that HMI LED's are not on as per shared pictures so either 24VDC power supply is not reaching to HMI or there could be DP cable or D logic issue.
It is also observed that DC1 LED strip status is Blue where plug is not in use, we will check that issue aswell.
As Charger is offline on SCB & remote check is not possible so we will be informing the region for site visit to check the charger & resolve the issue as soon as possible.
Regional service personnel will connect with you when Site visit will be planned.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma

Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0425633 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)

Note Below points:
1) Charger offline on SCB from 15/05/2025, Need to bring charger online on SCB( Check XF3 internet connection/Ethernet connection on XF3)
2) Check 24 DC Supply on HMI & DP cable connection
3) IF 24V found ok & DP cable is also ok then replace the existing DP cable with New cable & Check
4) If still HMI screen is black then update DLogic asper Q feedback & check the status
5) If still HMI screen is black then Use External Monitor with DP port, Connect DP cable between PLC & Monitor , Check the status.
6) If still HMI is black the Replace the HMI
Please carry
1) Spare DP cable
2) External Monitor with DP Port.
Follow the Q feedback for DP Cable change & Dlogic update.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/666/109816666/att_1147904/v1/SI_E_Q_Feedback_Q2302-SiD_HMI_Backlight_Router_2G_v4.pdf
